claims.claim: Receivers authorize execution using locally selected authority; incoming evidence does not install an issuer.
claims.limitation: Does not prove a dishonest receiver executed honestly.

claims.claim: The native funded agreement binds the original request, authority, Finding policy and funding domain.
claims.limitation: Experimental W0 amount is fixed to 100; not a universal work wire format.

claims.claim: Atomic reservations and terminal transfers conserve deposited funds in the abstract model.
claims.limitation: No refinement proof to Solidity or Rust.

claims.claim: Recorded earned claims cannot transition to refund in the specified state machine.
claims.limitation: An off-chain signature alone is not a recorded earned claim.

claims.claim: A separately funded earned child can collect after parent refund.
claims.limitation: Neither novel escrow nor guaranteed progress under failed verifier.

claims.claim: The finite explorer checks 5508 states and 132192 transitions.
claims.limitation: Not exhaustive arbitrary work graphs or all code.

claims.claim: 118 selected model traces are replayed against actual escrow bytecode.
claims.limitation: Not all model transitions; no public finality.

claims.claim: Ordinary SQL matches 312 steps along the same 118 monetary traces.
claims.limitation: Not a full networked alternative or independent authorship.

claims.claim: Negative model and bytecode mutations detect refund of an earned claim.
claims.limitation: One negative control does not establish complete fault detection.

claims.claim: Missing checker or custody evidence yields no decision rather than rejection.
claims.limitation: Verifier outage may still cause eventual timeout refund.

claims.claim: Execution uncertainty is not erased by monetary resolution.
claims.limitation: Historical process evidence is not current merged qualification.

claims.claim: The selected verifier and settlement domain remain trusted.
claims.limitation: Public rechecking does not force a dishonest verifier to sign correctly.

claims.claim: Pinned upstream ERC-8183 reproduces the child-payment economic outcome under equal capital and evaluator assumptions.
claims.limitation: Strong counterexample to an exclusive economic primitive; no independent operators or full admission-profile comparison.

claims.claim: Useful outputs can be verified materially more cheaply than produced.
claims.limitation: The deterministic OpenAPI inventory is inexpensive for the buyer to recompute.

claims.claim: One public contract substantially reduces repeated partner integration.
claims.limitation: Requires independently implemented provider and matched integration trial.

claims.claim: Live agents form economically useful teams with bounded loss.
claims.limitation: No live-agent economics or held-out commercial work result.

claims.claim: The composition is a foundational breakthrough beyond existing mechanisms.
claims.limitation: ERC-8183 and conventional escrow overlap substantially; no measured advantage yet.
